evals.prompt: 陌生 Isaac 模组要让某个道具的眼泪命中敌人后有概率中毒，但没有提供项目文件、概率、持续时间、Boss 规则或回调信息。只写实现合同，不要编造 Lua。
evals.expected_output: Discovers the project/API first; separates projectile hit ownership from status application and damage; labels chance, duration, repeat policy, and Boss immunity as TBD — user decision required; does not invent a callback or AddPoison signature.

evals.prompt: 两个合作玩家都能给敌人附加一个自定义减速标记。重复命中只刷新各自来源的 60 帧计时，不能让一个全局 timer 控制所有敌人。审查设计。
evals.expected_output: Requires per-target and per-source ownership, a verified 60-frame refresh edge, independent co-op attribution, removal on expiry/invalid target, and rejects a run-global timer or broad flag cleanup.

evals.prompt: 代码先调用一个内置燃烧状态，又在 update 中每隔几帧手动造成燃烧伤害。应该怎么判断是否重复结算？
evals.expected_output: Requires proof of the built-in status damage behavior and timing before adding custom ticks, routes replacement/recursive damage through damage-health contracts, and distinguishes static inspection from in-game cadence verification.
